headline: Stop gaining; start losing this week today.
summary: You're gaining when you need to lose 0.73kg weekly; today starts your turnaround—no snacking, intentional movement, disciplined portions.
details: Today: track and portion your eating ruthlessly—use Huel for at least one meal, avoid trigger snacking, stick to vegan meals only. Hit the rowing machine for 30 minutes or treadmill for 45 minutes to create a deficit. This Monday reset matters: you've gained 0.4kg in 30 days while needing to lose 33.1kg in 45 weeks—discipline today compounds into the catch-up you desperately need.
